jobs.title: Finance Director - Vijana2Thrive Project
jobs.direct_reports: Finance team leads and project finance staff

overview.about_sph: Swahilipot Hub Foundation is a non-profit organization founded in 2016 by Mahmoud Noor, nurturing youth talents in technology and creatives/arts through youth-led programs and community spaces for co-working, meeting, networking, and learning.
overview.position_summary: The Finance Director leads the financial strategy and operations for the Vijana2Thrive project, ensuring transparency, sustainability, and accountability while supporting finance teams and engaging key stakeholders, including donors.

jobs.scope: Provide strategic financial leadership for Vijana2Thrive, ensuring governance, compliance, responsible resource allocation, and long-term sustainability across the project portfolio.
responsibilities: Provide strategic financial leadership for the Vijana2Thrive project.
Oversee financial governance and deliver timely performance reporting.
Manage resource allocation to align budgets with project priorities.
Enforce risk management and compliance controls across all financial operations.
Lead financial planning, forecasting, and analysis for decision support.
Maintain strong donor and stakeholder communication on financial matters.
Coordinate internal and external audit processes and follow-up actions.
Coach and mentor the finance team to build capacity and ensure high performance.
Develop sustainability and innovative financing plans for the program.
Perform additional duties as assigned to support organizational goals.
key_areas: Deliver governance-compliant financial reporting and performance insights.
Oversee budgeting, planning, and reporting in line with IPSAS and IFRS standards.
Lead donor-funded project financial management and contract oversight.
Drive proactive risk management, audit readiness, and compliance enforcement.
Guide finance team leadership, capacity building, and talent development.
Champion sustainable and innovative financing strategies for youth programs.
qualifications: Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or Economics.
10+ years of progressive finance experience with at least 5 years in senior leadership.
Proven experience managing large donor-funded programs and partnerships.
Executive-level advisory experience with strong audit and risk oversight.
Demonstrated track record in building financial systems and high-performing teams.
Additional training in donor compliance, financial modeling, or risk/governance is an advantage.

application.submission: Detailed CV and cover letter emailed to hr@swahilipothub.co.ke
application.note: Use subject line 'Finance Director Application - Vijana2Thrive'. Applications accepted until EOD 14 November 2025.
